description: Explainable partner matching. Every match is returned with its component values and weighted contributions, never as a bare score.

component_definitions.tag_overlap: Share of the challenge's capability tags the partner also holds.
component_definitions.district_proximity: 1.0 on a shared district; otherwise exp(-distance_km / 150) when a distance is supplied, else 0.0.

known_limitation: District proximity is exact-district unless distances are supplied. The project has no validated district-centroid table yet, so no distances are invented.
